name: Flashpoint
description: An oversized split heading meets a single angular portrait, with a struck-match rail and a broad neutral reading page.

name: Twin Wicks
description: Two stacked candle-window portraits form a narrow side column beside a bookish title and an uninterrupted letter.

name: Backdraft
description: An image-free page uses a rising stepped crest, compressed display type and a diagonal exhaust edge.

name: Heat Veil
description: A soft italic title floats above a clean letter, while a panoramic portrait and rising heat lines finish the page.

name: Pyre Script
description: A spare centred folio with a fan of matchsticks, a framed nameplate and a delicate ruled reading panel.

name: Fuse Touch
description: A modern narrow phone with an offset camera strip, square contact portrait, luminous side fuse and curved message bubbles.

name: Burner Line
description: A compact rugged handset with a segmented signal meter, recessed message screen and a three-button control deck.

name: Flare Cast
description: A landscape message tablet places a portrait in a slim right bezel beside a wide, softly inset conversation screen.

name: Kindle Link
description: A tall chat phone separates two contact tiles with a bright vertical wick, above a shared conversation and a wide bottom speaker.

name: Pilot Light
description: A gently curved phone with a large lock-screen clock, a tiny pilot indicator and stacked notification-style messages.

name: Sparklet
description: A miniature open reply with an angled ignition mark and a broad, split-colour title rule.

name: Wicktip
description: A narrow candle-window portrait rises beside a short reply, grounded by a delicate wick and a compact name strip.

name: Coalprint
description: A squat, chamfered keepsake with a compressed title, neutral centre and a fine faceted coal impression.

name: Firefly Pair
description: Two tiny square portraits sit at opposite corners of a compact reply, joined by fine spark trails.

name: Last Flicker
description: A short note with a low horizontal portrait, an offset italic heading and a fading three-part flame rail.
